2026-01-07.title: FIRST PRACTICE OF THE SPRING SEMESTER!
2026-01-07.about: We... are... BACK!! Kick off the spring semester with our first official practice of 2026! Come shake off the break rust, reconnect with the team, and start this semester strong! Remember: This Practice is open to ALL Utah Climbing Team members. Expect a chill but stoked sesh, plenty of climbing, and good vibes all around. I WILL SEE YOU THERE!!
